QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] All His Fault
QuestInfo.0: You did Chen's homework for him. Ask him if this fixed all of the problems ever.
QuestInfo.1: Chen believes his hatred of homework caused the crises in Kritias. You're beginning to develop a theory that the crisis was caused by something real, instead. \r\nSpeak with Bianca, one of Chen's classmates.
QuestInfo.2: Chen believed his hatred of homework caused the crises in Kritias.\r\nYou decided go speak with his classmate, Bianca, in search of less stupid theory.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  26,151,650
Can proceed to [Kritias] A Bloodthirsty Schoolgirl

0.0: It didn't work? Gosh, where did I go wrong?\r\nOh, hi! Thanks for helping me before. I thought things'd go back to normal, but... but... Sigh.
0.1: I skipped school 'cause I didn't have my homework done. I secretly wished the academy would blow up so I wouldn't have to do it. And guess what?
0.2: That very day, the Black Mage attacked! See? This is all my fault! I never wanted anybody to get hurt, but I've got this awful power...
0.3: That's why I got you to help me with my homework! I figured if I turned it in, everything would go back to normal! Professor B gave me a gold star, but the academy's still closed!
0.4: So that's that. You know my dark secret.\r\nThe academy wasn't even that bad. I just didn't like homework, that's all! Golly gee...
0.5: At least #bBianca's#k having a good ol' time. Have you met her? That girl's super scary with a capital S!

yes.0: What is #bBianca#k up to, anyway? She's usually sleeping through class, but now she's super hyper. You don't think... She isn't the #bBlack Mage in disguise#k, is she?!
yes.1: Wh-what if it's true?!\r\nOh gosh, this could be my chance to be a big old hero...!

no.0: At least she didn't make the school blow up.\r\nI can't even use the cafeteria. I'm hungry. I haven't had magic tater tots in ages!

1.0: Hey there, fresh meat. You aren't a student here, are you?

yes.0: You're from Ereve, eh? Yeah, I know that turf.

npc.0: #bBianca#k is the girl right next to me. She must be up to something! Golly, I hope she isn't an evil mastermind in disguise!
